name: AWS Lambda Blue-Green Deployment Strategy
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy for AWS Lambda to ensure zero-downtime updates and seamless rollbacks.
description: This project focuses on implementing a blue-green deployment strategy specifically for AWS Lambda functions. The goal is to create a robust deployment process that allows for zero-downtime updates, ensuring that users experience no interruptions during the transition between application versions. The strategy will involve setting up two identical environments, 'blue' and 'green', where one serves live traffic while the other is idle. Updates will be deployed to the idle environment, and once verified, traffic will be switched over seamlessly. This approach not only facilitates quick rollbacks in case of issues but also enhances the overall deployment process by allowing for thorough testing in a production-like environment. The project will include detailed documentation and best practices for maintaining the blue-green deployment strategy, ensuring that your team can manage future updates with confidence.
deliverables: Detailed deployment plan and strategy document (document)
